title: Strength of Correlation between PSLE Scores and Socio-economic Status over the Years
what_it_is: Strength of Correlation between PSLE Scores and Socio-economic Status over the Years

sections.label: PSLE results and socio-economic status
sections.summary: The correlation between PSLE results and socio-economic status has remained stable over the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The correlation between the Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) results and socio-economic status (SES) has remained stable over the past three years.

sections.label: Bottom-25% SES students in PISA 2022
sections.summary: In PISA 2022, students from the bottom-25% SES outperformed the average OECD student in Reading, Mathematics, Science and Creative Thinking.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Based on Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development's (OECD's) Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) 2022, our students from the bottom-25% SES outperformed the average OECD student in all core domains of Reading, Mathematics and Science, and in Creative Thinking.

sections.label: Doubling primary schools receiving resources
sections.summary: After observing improvements in attendance, behaviour and progression, the number of primary schools receiving additional resources was doubled over two years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Having observed improvements in students' attendance, behaviour and progression, we have doubled the number of primary schools receiving these additional resources over the past two years.

sections.label: Median PSLE scores of lower-income students
sections.summary: For students from lower-income households, the range of results is large, but the median PSLE score has been very stable over the past few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Mainly at the broad and the entire national cohort level, for students from lower-income households, as proxied from the MOE Financial Assistance Scheme, the range of results is large, but over the past few years, the median PSLE score has been very stable.
